comment: Independent do.c dropx() witness for a box whose lock picking was interrupted. A debug gnomish Healer drops a wished locked large box, wishes a credit card, creates a newt beside her and starts unlocking the box; the newt interrupts, leaving lock.c xlock.box set. She picks the box up and drops it again: C's drop is ordinary ("You drop a locked large box."), since only obfree() or a level change resets xlock.box.
